topHook: POV: your pipe burst. Their phone rings.

scenes.vo: [urgent, curious] POV: water's coming through your ceiling. And by Invoca's data, twenty-seven percent of calls to home-services businesses go unanswered.
scenes.label: of home-services calls unanswered (Invoca)
scenes.visual: Drip from the ceiling; phone in hand

scenes.vo: So you grab your phone and call the first plumber you can find.

scenes.visual: Phone rings in an empty van across town

scenes.vo: You stand there, holding a bucket, listening to a recording.
That's more than one in four calls.
[quiet] And maybe they weren't ignoring you. Maybe they were under someone else's sink.
scenes.visual: Plumber's legs under a sink; phone buzzing on the floor

scenes.vo: [quiet] A text back, right away, would have told you they'd seen your call and would ring you back.
[quiet] Instead? The water's still coming. So:
